description: A heredoc inside an interpolation can reuse the enclosing heredoc's marker
notes: The spec says a heredoc ends when its identifier appears again on a line of its own, which the inner closing line does. hashicorp/hcl keeps a stack of open heredocs and only checks lines of literal text against the innermost one (heredocs in scanTokens, hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), so the first EOT closes the inner heredoc.
